text:
London gets much more rain than Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Dubai and Riyadh (about 100 mm each), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), Los Angeles (about 370 mm), and Madrid (about 440 mm), while averaging roughly 600 mm. The shared note about New York is wrong: NYC averages roughly 1,250 mm a year, so it is much wetter than London, not drier. These are approximate long-term averages from memory, not checked against a live source.
CONFIDENCE: 85
